method: Geometric means of five paired run ratios; two-sided 95% t intervals on log ratios, df=4. Intervals are unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
limits: Condition order varied by pre-specified block; shared-cluster and time effects remain possible.
GPU assignment policies mixed; per-comparison same-GPU counts are recorded.
Qwen3-0.6B on one full H100 per run; larger models are untested.
Dynamo worker policy varied; frontend remained allowed and CPU quota constrained.
CPU/request is an aligned cgroup estimate excluding ingress and mesh sidecars.
Restore changes more than io_uring, including an additional seccomp layer.
ITL is per-request mean token spacing; sparse low-volume p99s are flagged.
Queue counters do not identify io_uring opcodes or prove a fallback mechanism.
